scenario: Kate bought a green plant for the office to bring good energy. One week later the plant is brown and dying. Kate asks the team: 'Who has watered it? Have you watered it at all?' Den says he has never liked office plants. Alex has forgotten about it — he has four kids at home and a busy life. Then Pol admits: 'I have poured my green smoothie into it. I thought it was good for the leaves.' Kate sighs. In the end Pol becomes the office plant-keeper. Warm and funny. Use present perfect (have/has + past participle, 'Have you ever...', 'I have never...') a lot.
